description: Мастер на все руки, а мастера нет
summary: An integrated multi-layered Martian atlas designed to help future astronauts plan and carry out safe Marswalks and scientific traverses. Fusing data from over 10 NASA planetary missions, the platform delivers 4 multispectral basemaps with split-screen swipe comparison, autonomous chasm-avoiding SafeNav routing, and in-situ microclimate telemetry—from atmospheric density to the liquid water Armstrong limit and local gravity.
details:
The site parses 4 kinds of Mars' maps from the NASA data. The site has 4 layers of maps: optical, surface and 2 IR maps for different purposes. Each one can be compared with the other one with the slider feature (left panel and the button on the top right corner of the map).
The left panel contains shortcuts to all 9 of the landing sites and 7 landmarks. Left panel has safe pathfinder as well, that will create the best route from one point to another.
On your right, there is an information panel, that contains data about the object you have clicked before:

  • The first tab has geological information about the place.
  • The second tab shows us the weather and the climate. At the bottom of it you can also calculate your weight on the Mars and the height of your jump.
  • The third tab is the telemetry of your last created route. There you can find all the information you might want to see.
